predictions.articleTitle: Mladost DG vs Arsenal Tivat Preview & Match Analysis: Can Interim Tivat Hold Out at DG Arena?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Mladost DG vs Arsenal Tivat projects as a tight, low-scoring relegation contest favoring Home Win / Draw under 2.5 goals.

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Blunt Mladost DG attack faces Arsenal Tivat's new interim coaching trio.

spf.comment: Covers a narrow 1:0 Mladost DG win and a 1:1 stalemate, as neither a winless host nor an unsettled visitor justifies a single-outcome call.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 2.27 combined lambda (60.4% Under 2.5 baseline) and both clubs averaging under 0.75 goals per league match.

btts.comment: Aligned with the 54.1% Poisson baseline, Arsenal Tivat's eight scoreless outings in 14 games, and Mladost DG's four blanks in five.

score.comment: 1:0 reflects Mladost DG's home continuity and September H2H win, while 1:1 accounts for their 1.67 goals-conceded average.

goals.comment: 2 and 1 total goals represent the two highest-probability Poisson buckets at 26.6% and 23.5% respectively.

bqc.comment: Four of the last five league meetings were 0:0 at halftime before either a late home breakthrough or a level finish.
